title: Maternal danger signs & hypertension triage
who_baseline: WHO recommendations for prevention and treatment of pre-eclampsia and eclampsia (2011)
WHO recommendations on antenatal care for a positive pregnancy experience (2016)

rules.title: Severe hypertension in pregnancy ≥20 weeks
rules.action: Emergency referral to comprehensive emergency obstetric care

source.baseline: WHO 2011 pre-eclampsia/eclampsia: severe hypertension = SBP ≥160 or DBP ≥110 mmHg
source.local: IN-DEMO pack §4.2: route directly to FRU/CEmONC with ambulance

rules.title: Convulsions in pregnancy
rules.action: Emergency referral to comprehensive emergency obstetric care

source.baseline: WHO 2011 pre-eclampsia/eclampsia: eclampsia is an obstetric emergency
source.local: IN-DEMO pack §4.1: call 108; route to FRU/CEmONC

rules.title: Heavy vaginal bleeding in pregnancy
rules.action: Emergency referral to comprehensive emergency obstetric care

source.baseline: WHO ANC 2016 danger signs: vaginal bleeding
source.local: IN-DEMO pack §4.3: route to facility with blood transfusion

rules.title: Hypertension with severe features
rules.action: Urgent referral (same hour) to comprehensive emergency obstetric care

source.baseline: WHO 2011: hypertension with severe headache / visual disturbance / epigastric pain indicates severe pre-eclampsia features
source.local: IN-DEMO pack §4.4: urgent referral to FRU

rules.title: Hypertension in pregnancy without danger signs
rules.action: Same-day antenatal BP review at PHC

source.baseline: WHO ANC 2016: hypertension in pregnancy requires assessment
WHO ANC 2016 danger signs: severe headache, blurred vision
source.local: IN-DEMO pack §3.1: ASHA to measure BP and escalate per §4

text.en: Can you measure her blood pressure now?
text.hi: क्या आप अभी उनका ब्लड प्रेशर नाप सकती हैं?
text.bn: আপনি কি এখন ওনার রক্তচাপ মাপতে পারবেন?

prior_modifiers.reason: Record: gestational hypertension; last BP 151/98 yesterday

text.en: Has she had any fits or convulsions?
text.hi: क्या उन्हें कोई दौरा या झटके आए हैं?

text.en: Is she having any vaginal bleeding?
text.hi: क्या उन्हें योनि से खून आ रहा है?

text.en: Is her vision blurred, or is she seeing spots or flashes?
text.hi: क्या उन्हें धुंधला दिख रहा है या आँखों के आगे चमक/धब्बे दिख रहे हैं?
text.bn: ওনার কি চোখে ঝাপসা দেখছেন বা আলোর ঝলক দেখছেন?

text.en: Does she have pain in the upper abdomen, below the ribs?
text.hi: क्या उन्हें पेट के ऊपरी हिस्से में, पसलियों के नीचे दर्द है?
text.bn: ওনার কি পেটের উপরের দিকে, পাঁজরের নিচে ব্যথা আছে?
